_draft: Gift designs: names, lines and art briefs are DRAFTS (12 Oct 2026). Gifts carry their own designs and are not tied to a series; `story` only links to a book that shares the idea. Every design is one small, quiet Pim scene. Postcards and greeting cards: one design per pack of 10, no mixed packs.

mug.name: The Moon
mug.about: Pim sits on the crescent moon among three small stars. On the other side: “I chose the moon.”

mug.name: The Garden
mug.about: Pim waters two tulips while a bee looks on. On the other side: “I chose the garden.”

mug.name: The Red Balloon
mug.about: Pim holds one red balloon in front of a little house. On the other side: “I chose the red balloon.”

mug.name: The Train
mug.about: Pim rides in the wagon behind a little train. On the other side: “I chose the train.”

mug.name: Snow Day
mug.about: Pim stands beside a snowman with a red scarf, snow falling. On the other side: “I chose the snowman.”

mug.name: One More Page
mug.about: Pim reads on top of a stack of books. On the other side, the words every grown-up hears at bedtime: “One more page.”

tote.name: Library Day
tote.about: Pim carries a stack of books, a crayon tucked on top, with the words “Carry the story.”

tote.name: Five Crayons
tote.about: Pim lines up five crayons, ready to choose, with the words “Colour the ending.”

tote.name: Little Stories
tote.about: The Telning colophon, the small open book that forms a T, with Pim beside it and the line “Little stories, growing minds.”

tote.name: To the Moon
tote.about: Pim in a little rocket on the way to the moon, with the words “To the moon and back.”

tote.name: Grow Slowly
tote.about: Pim waters three tulips of different heights, a bee nearby, with the words “Grow slowly.”

tote.name: What Would You Choose?
tote.about: Pim sits and smiles under a question bubble, with Pim’s favourite question: “What would you choose?”

postcards.name: Happy Midsummer
postcards.about: Pim among daisies under a flag garland on a long light summer evening.

cards.name: To the Moon
cards.words: Love you to the moon and back.
cards.about: Pim holds a heart-shaped balloon floating up to the moon: for Valentine’s, Mother’s or Father’s Day.
